display_name: Phase1 噪声门控四专家恢复网络
description: 以源域人工加噪和置信伪标签训练四专家选择器，使用源域验证确定能量门控；固定后进行 Phase1 地面开发测试。

data.representation: Phase1 source noisy received IQ, frozen expert outputs and Tri-SIG-TIME class probabilities
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; L_s labels and high-confidence U_s clean-teacher pseudo-labels
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: L_s true labels; U_s teacher pseudo-labels with clean confidence >=0.95; no U_s labels, V or test IQ
data.augmentation: Source views 01 and 20 with seeded added 15 and 5 dB Gaussian noise, plus clean and unaugmented

permissions.regime: Phase1 L_s true labels, U_s clean teacher pseudo-labels and source IQ only; no V/test during source training
permissions.query_use: Frozen per-record received IQ and frozen expert/F outputs only; no clean or label at inference
permissions.claim_scope: Previously observed single-seed Phase1 development test, not blind

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen DURA, Tri-SIG-TIME SSL, source-trained boundary/feature models and 26-64-4 source-trained router
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Frozen F/DURA provenance and exact expert checkpoint and source router asset SHA-256
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Four frozen experts; router source-trained with L_s labels and U_s clean-teacher pseudo-labels, source-selected gate
checkpoint.selection_rule: Source validation epoch 20, probability difference 0 and log-DURA-energy <= -1.0; fixed before target predictions

metric_names: Tri-SIG-TIME raw clean, per-scene raw and restored accuracy, macro F1 and clean-relative gap
dimensions: 168000 Phase1 ground test physical records x seven views
metrics_plan.targets_ref: Each of six restored practical scenes within 3 percentage points of same reader raw clean; restored clean degradation at most 1 percentage point

notes: 四专家为原始 IQ、DURA、边界学生和特征条件恢复模型；使用冻结 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 的四组类别概率以及原始/DURA 的对数能量预测选择。
源域训练使用 L_s 真标签和高置信 clean 教师 U_s 伪标签，源域人工加噪 15 dB 和 5 dB；源验证固定 20 轮模型、概率差 0 和 DURA 对数能量门限 −1。
源留出 799 条有效记录，两个强噪声视图分别净修复 57 和 63，两个原始源视图变化 −1 和 +1；专家本身训练见过源记录。
固定的 Phase1 测试只读取每条接收 IQ，不读取 clean 配对或标签；七视图全部预测固定后 CPU 才接入 TX 真值。
本方案受已观察的 Phase1 测试专家互补上界启发，故该测试非独立盲测；同时报告百分点和相对百分比下降。
首次发布包因 Windows Git 默认换行转换而未通过源域权重字节校验；保留原发布包，修正打包并使用独立 v2 发布路径。首次校验未读取 Phase1 测试 IQ 或真值。

rows.method: Source-noise-trained four-expert router with validated DURA-energy guard
rows.purpose: Select received or restored IQ to exploit expert complementarity while guarding ordinary source views
rows.seed_notes: Source split 2026110171, additive noise seed 2026110172 plus view offsets, router initialization 2026110173, fitting order 2026110174; fixed original Phase1 test views
rows.scenario: Source clean, original simulated views 01/20 and 15/5 dB noise; fixed Phase1 clean and six practical received views
